statBlock.name: Flying Snake
statBlock.description: A small venomous snake that can fly and swim.

sections.Traits: Flyby. The snake can fly out of an enemy's reach without provoking an Opportunity Attack.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 1 Piercing damage and 5 (2d4) Poison damage.

statBlock.name: Giant Axe Beak
statBlock.description: A giant flightless bird that fights for territory with dinosaurs in remote primeval lands.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Sharpened Beak attack and one Talons attack.
Sharpened Beak. Melee attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 18 (2d12 + 5) Slashing damage. The axe beak chooses a creature within 5 ft. of the target to take 6 (1d12) Slashing damage.
Talons. Melee attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 14 (2d8 + 5) Piercing damage, and a Large or smaller creature hit falls Prone.

statBlock.name: Giant Eagle
statBlock.description: A celestial eagle that strikes with radiant talons.

sections.Languages: Speaks Celestial and understands Common and Primordial (Auran).
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) Slashing damage and 3 (1d6) Radiant damage.

statBlock.name: Giant Elk
statBlock.description: A celestial elk that bowls over foes with a charge.

sections.Languages: Speaks Celestial and understands Common, Elvish, and Sylvan.
sections.Actions: Ram. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage and 5 (2d4) Radiant damage. If the elk moved at least 20 ft. straight toward a Huge or smaller creature immediately before hitting it, that creature takes another 5 (2d4) Bludgeoning damage and falls Prone.

statBlock.name: Giant Owl
statBlock.description: A celestial owl that can detect magic and spy on distant places.

sections.Languages: Speaks Celestial and understands Common, Elvish, and Sylvan.
sections.Traits: Flyby. The owl can fly out of an enemy's reach without provoking an Opportunity Attack.
sections.Actions: Talons. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d10 + 2) Slashing damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell with Wisdom and without components.
At will. Detect Evil and Good, Detect Magic.
1/day. Clairvoyance.

statBlock.name: Giant Vulture
statBlock.description: A giant carrion bird whose gouging attack poisons its prey.

sections.Traits: Pack Tactics. The vulture has Advantage when attacking a creature if at least one of the vulture's allies is within 5 ft. of that creature and is not Incapacitated.
sections.Actions: Gouge. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 9 (2d6 + 2) Piercing damage and leaves the target Poisoned until the end of its next turn.

statBlock.name: Githyanki Dracomancer
statBlock.description: A githyanki spellcaster who upholds the pact with red dragons and conjures their fire in battle.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Draconic Strike attacks.
Draconic Strike. Melee or ranged attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 120 ft. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage and 17 (5d6) Fire damage. The target is Frightened until the start of the dracomancer's next turn.
Conjured Dragon's Breath (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 90-ft. Cone must make a DC 18 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 27 (6d8) Fire damage and 27 (6d8) Force damage. On a success, it takes half damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell with Intelligence (save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks). Omit all components.
At will. Mage Hand (the hand is Invisible).
2/day each. Nondetection (self only), Plane Shift, Tongues.
sections.Bonus actions: Misty Step (3/day). Cast Misty Step using Intelligence without components.

statBlock.name: Gulthias Blight
statBlock.description: A cursed plant that feeds on blood and spreads its corruption by planting lesser blights.

sections.Traits: Blight Seeds. At the end of a Long Rest, the blight expels 1d6 seeds into unoccupied ground spaces within 30 ft. After 24 hours, each seed becomes a creature under its control. Roll 1d8 for each seed. On 1–4 it becomes a Twig Blight, on 5–6 a Needle Blight, and on 7–8 a Vine Blight.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any mix of Slam and Thorn Volley, and use Life-Draining Root.
Slam. Melee attack, +12 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 25 (4d8 + 7) Bludgeoning damage.
Thorn Volley. Ranged attack, +12 to hit, range 60/180 ft. A hit deals 20 (3d8 + 7) Piercing damage.
Life-Draining Root. Choose one Huge or smaller creature the blight can see within 30 ft. On a failed DC 20 Constitution save, the creature takes 14 (2d6 + 7) Necrotic damage and is Grappled by one of the blight's six roots (escape DC 17). Until the grapple ends, the creature is Restrained and takes 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns. The creature's Hit Point maximum decreases by the Necrotic damage it takes from this action, and the blight regains that many Hit Points.
